templates.scenario_zh: 客户描述过于笼统，无法判断问题；需要基础信息后再查后台或分析
templates.scenario_en: The customer's description is too vague to determine the issue. Basic information is required before checking the backend or doing further troubleshooting and analysis.

templates.scenario_zh: 客户未提供 VIN 或 VIN 非 17 位；客户把VIN理解为车牌号；需要引导客户找到 VIN
templates.scenario_en: The customer did not provide a VIN, or the VIN provided is not 17 characters long. The customer may have mistaken the VIN for the license plate number, so they need guidance on how to find the correct VIN on the vehicle or in related documents.

templates.scenario_zh: 客户提供的 VIN 查询不到或照片不是车辆 VIN
templates.scenario_en: Apply this template when the customer provides a VIN that cannot be found in the system, or when the photo/screenshot provided is not the vehicle VIN. The customer may have entered the wrong VIN, sent an invalid VIN, or attached the wrong vehicle identification image.

templates.scenario_zh: 文字描述不足；需要看到完整操作路径和报错
templates.scenario_en: The customer's text description is insufficient to identify the issue. We need the complete operation path and the exact error shown, such as screenshots or video, in order to carry out troubleshooting and confirm whether the problem is in the app or the infotainment.
keywords_existing: app not working but no details
vehicle not working but no details
unclear whether app or car screen
keywords_all: app not working but no details
vehicle not working but no details
unclear whether app or car screen

templates.scenario_zh: 已收到 VIN/视频/截图，需要技术团队继续排查
templates.scenario_en: The customer has already provided the VIN, video, and/or screenshot, and the case needs to be forwarded to the technical team for further troubleshooting. This applies when the required information has been received and backend or technical investigation should continue.

templates.scenario_zh: 账号提示在另一台设备登录，被踢下线，频繁要求重新登录
templates.scenario_en: Apply this template when the customer reports that their account appears to be logged in on another device, causing them to be signed out or kicked offline. The issue may happen repeatedly, with the app frequently requiring the customer to log in again.
keywords_extracted: app asks to log in again
keywords_all: app asks to log in again

templates.scenario_zh: 忘记登录密码、重置密码、无法设置新密码
templates.scenario_en: Apply this template when the customer forgot the login password, needs to reset the password, or is unable to set a new password in the app. This includes cases such as incorrect password, not receiving or using an expired verification link or code, and reset failure during troubleshooting.

templates.scenario_zh: 注册或重置时收不到邮箱验证码/验证链接过期
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer does not receive the email verification code during registration or password reset, or when the verification link/code in the email has expired. It applies to account verification issues related to email delivery or expired email verification.

templates.scenario_zh: 忘记 PIN / 安全码 / 远控码，或绑车时被要求输入 PIN
templates.scenario_en: Apply this template when the customer forgot the PIN, security code, or remote control code, or when the customer is asked to enter a PIN while trying to bind the vehicle in the app. This includes cases where the customer cannot complete vehicle binding because the required PIN/code is unknown.

templates.scenario_zh: 更换手机号/邮箱/新手机登录
templates.scenario_en: Apply this template when the customer needs to update the mobile number or email linked to the app account, or when the customer is logging in on a new phone. This also includes cases where the old phone is lost or unavailable and the customer needs help accessing the app again.

templates.scenario_zh: 二手车/新车扫码提示车辆已绑定，需要解绑前任车主
templates.scenario_en: Applicable when a customer with a used vehicle or new vehicle scans the QR and the app indicates the vehicle is already bound, so the previous owner's binding must be removed before the customer can bind the vehicle.

templates.scenario_zh: 后台显示车辆未绑定任何账号，但客户仍无法绑车
templates.scenario_en: The backend shows that the vehicle is not bound to any account, but the customer still cannot bind the vehicle in the app. This scenario applies when binding fails even though no existing account is associated with the VIN.

templates.scenario_zh: 不会绑车，不知道如何绑车
templates.scenario_en: The backend shows that the vehicle is already bound to an account. The customer needs to confirm whether this is their own account and whether they have already resolved the issue by themselves.

templates.scenario_zh: 后台显示已绑定到某账号，需要客户确认是否本人/是否已自行解决问题
templates.scenario_en: The previous owner has been successfully unbound from the vehicle, or the customer's request to unbind the vehicle has been completed. Use this when confirming that the unbind process is already finished.

templates.scenario_zh: 已成功解绑前任车主/客户请求解绑已完成
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports that binding the vehicle by scanning the QR code fails because the app or infotainment shows a date, time, or time zone error. The issue occurs during the bind vehicle process and specifically indicates incorrect date/time/time zone settings.

templates.scenario_zh: 扫码绑车提示日期/时间/时区错误
templates.scenario_en: This scenario applies when a customer has multiple vehicles under one account, wants to delete or unbind a vehicle that does not belong to them, or is asking where to find the vehicle management section in the app. It also covers requests related to managing added vehicles under the same account.

templates.scenario_zh: App 车态不更新、显示旧数据、里程/电量/位置不一致、APP突然不工作/不连接
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports that the app vehicle status is not updating and still shows outdated data. This includes inconsistent or incorrect mileage, battery level, or vehicle location displayed in the app compared with the actual vehicle.
keywords_existing: app is not working from， The network is not available. Please try again later.
keywords_all: app is not working from， the network is not available. please try again later.

templates.scenario_zh: App 显示 Vehicle Not Responded / 远控超时 / 车辆锁车后短时间不可达
templates.scenario_en: App shows Vehicle Not Responded / remote timeout after lock; wake the telematics.

templates.scenario_zh: 网络不稳定、远控失败、疑似 TBox/TCU 网络问题
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports unstable network connectivity or remote control failure, and the issue is suspected to be related to the vehicle TBox/TCU network connection. This includes cases where the app cannot communicate reliably with the vehicle due to telematics network abnormalities.

templates.scenario_zh: App显示发送成功但车辆无动作
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports that remote climate control cannot be turned on: the app shows the command was sent successfully, but the vehicle does not respond or take any action. This includes cases where remote air conditioning or heating appears successful in the app, yet the vehicle remains unchanged.

templates.scenario_zh: 远控功能报错error code 59（Authentication Failure from PT）
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports that the app shows the Privacy Notice or privacy agreement has not been accepted, causing vehicle control features to be unavailable. This also includes cases where the customer believes they already accepted it but the app still indicates it was not accepted.

templates.scenario_zh: 远控功能报错error code 47
templates.scenario_en: Remote control error code 47; T-Box communication; dealer diagnostic refresh.

templates.scenario_zh: App 提示未接受隐私协议/Privacy Notice，导致车控不可用
templates.scenario_en: The customer reports that the Charge Management page in the app shows no data, while the app home page still displays vehicle information such as battery level. This applies when charging-related details are missing only in Charge Management, rather than all vehicle data being unavailable.

templates.scenario_zh: 远程空调温度调节滑块/座椅加热/方向盘加热等功能缺失
templates.scenario_en: Use this scenario when the customer reports a specific error code and the vehicle control command fails in the app, but the vehicle status can still be read normally. This applies to cases where remote control functions do not work while vehicle state information remains available.

templates.scenario_zh: Charge Management 充电管理页面无数据，但首页有电量等数据
templates.scenario_en: Apply this template when the customer reports that the app frequently sends abnormal alert, intrusion alert, tire pressure, or similar warning notifications, or suspects the alerts are false alarms. This includes repeated notifications that seem incorrect or triggered without an actual vehicle issue.

templates.scenario_zh: 车辆无法充电、充电中断、V2L 停止、充电口锁扣异常
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports that the vehicle cannot charge, charging is interrupted, V2L stops during use, or the charging port latch works abnormally, such as not locking or not releasing. The issue may involve AC charging current, charging port behavior, or repeated charging failure that requires troubleshooting.

templates.scenario_zh: 满电显示续航下降/电池健康或续航计算疑问
templates.scenario_en: The customer reports that the displayed driving range is lower than expected when the vehicle is fully charged, or has questions about battery health or how the range is calculated. This scenario applies when the customer is concerned about reduced range shown at 100% charge rather than a charging failure.

templates.scenario_zh: 预约充电不执行、时间自动跳变
templates.scenario_en: The customer reports that scheduled charging does not execute as set, and the charging time in the app or vehicle automatically jumps to a different time. This applies when the customer says the charging schedule is ignored or the configured time changes by itself.

templates.scenario_zh: 客户希望查看充电历史、kWh、电费报销、订阅/流量使用
templates.scenario_en: The customer wants to view charging history, kWh usage, electricity expense reimbursement details, or subscription and mobile data usage information for the vehicle/app services. This applies when the customer is asking where to check these records or usage details.

templates.scenario_zh: App 中找不到用户手册/找不到指定车型/年份语言不对
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer cannot find the user manual in the app, cannot find the specified vehicle model, or finds that the manual year or language does not match the vehicle. The issue is about manual availability or incorrect model, year, or language selection in the app.

templates.scenario_zh: 要求下载 PDF 用户手册
templates.scenario_en: The customer is requesting a PDF version of the user manual and wants help downloading or receiving the manual file.

templates.scenario_zh: AVN/FICM 未激活、车机激活失败、Security Audit/AES/AVN ID does not exist
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer's vehicle infotainment or FICM is not activated, when vehicle activation on the infotainment fails, or when errors such as Security Audit, AES, or "AVN ID does not exist" appear during activation or troubleshooting.

templates.scenario_zh: Does not have vehicle information / 10001 / 生态应用不可用
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports that the app or infotainment shows no vehicle information, displays error code 10001, or indicates that ecosystem apps / online services are unavailable for the vehicle.

templates.scenario_zh: TBox/TCU 更换后无法绑车或远控
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer cannot bind the vehicle in the app or use remote control after a TBox/TCU replacement because the new TBox has not been activated. This applies to cases after parts replacement where the vehicle's telematics unit is new but backend activation is incomplete or missing.

templates.scenario_zh: Apple CarPlay / Android Auto 断连、无法连接、无线不支持
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports that Apple CarPlay or Android Auto disconnects, cannot connect, or is not supported in wireless mode on the vehicle infotainment system. This includes unstable wired connection, failed connection attempts, or cases where the customer expects wireless CarPlay or Android Auto but the vehicle does not support it.

templates.scenario_zh: 蓝牙电话对方听不到、音质差、通话几分钟后麦克风失效
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports Bluetooth phone call issues in the vehicle, such as the other party cannot hear the customer, poor call audio quality, or the microphone stops working after a few minutes of calling. This applies to hands-free calling problems related to the vehicle infotainment Bluetooth connection.

templates.scenario_zh: 车机网络有 4G 信号但天气/YouTube/TikTok/在线服务不可用；车载流量/订阅查询
templates.scenario_en: The customer reports that the vehicle infotainment shows a 4G signal, but online services such as weather, YouTube, TikTok, or other connected functions are unavailable. This scenario also includes inquiries about in-vehicle data traffic, eSIM, or subscription status related to these services.

templates.scenario_zh: 导航语音语言缺失：除了英语、法语、德语、西班牙语以外的其他语言；无法设置导航语音至除了英语、法语、德语、西班牙语以外的其他语言
templates.scenario_en: The customer reports that the navigation voice guidance language is missing in the vehicle or app, such as Italian, Dutch, Turkish, or other specific languages. Use this scenario when the customer cannot find or select the expected navigation voice language.

templates.scenario_zh: 地图更新失败、地图资源缺失、导航媒体文件不可用
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports that a map update failed, map resources are missing, or navigation media files in the infotainment are unavailable. This includes issues during map data update or when required navigation content cannot be accessed on the vehicle.

templates.scenario_zh: GPS 定位偏移、Live Traffic/Mapgrade/在线导航数据异常
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports GPS location drift or abnormal online navigation data in the vehicle infotainment, including issues with Live Traffic or Mapgrade services. This includes cases where the vehicle location is inaccurate, map-related data is incorrect, or navigation content appears abnormal.

templates.scenario_zh: 地区不支持、跨区车辆、区域 App 不匹配、标准 iSMART 不可用
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer’s vehicle is from a different market or region, the customer is in an unsupported region, or the regional app does not match the vehicle, so standard iSMART is not available. This includes cross-region or used imported vehicles that cannot bind vehicle or use iSMART services normally.

templates.scenario_zh: 车型/配置不支持 iSMART 或远控功能
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer's vehicle model or configuration does not support iSMART or remote control features. This includes cases where the vehicle cannot use the app, bind vehicle functions, or connected services because the hardware or configuration is unsupported.

templates.scenario_zh: 客户询问最新娱乐系统/软件版本/是否可更新
templates.scenario_en: Customer asks about the latest infotainment or software version for the vehicle, or whether the vehicle can be updated. This includes questions about version availability, current version comparison, and update eligibility.

templates.scenario_zh: DAB/RDS 电台名称/Logo 不显示、卡住、乱码
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports that the DAB/RDS radio station name or logo in the vehicle infotainment does not display, gets stuck, or shows garbled characters. The issue concerns incorrect or abnormal radio information presentation rather than general reception troubleshooting.

templates.scenario_zh: 车机界面文案截断、语言错乱、中文界面、显示黑屏/白屏/重启
templates.scenario_en: Apply this template when the customer reports infotainment display issues such as truncated interface text, mixed-up or incorrect language, the infotainment stuck in a Chinese interface, or the screen showing black screen, white screen, or repeated reboot. The issue is related to abnormal infotainment UI display or startup behavior in the vehicle.

templates.scenario_zh: 尾门、车窗、雨刮、钥匙、门锁、灯光、座椅记忆等车身功能异常
templates.scenario_en: The customer reports abnormal body function issues with the vehicle, such as the tailgate, windows, wipers, key, door locks, lights, or seat memory not working properly. This applies to body-related feature malfunctions rather than app, bind vehicle, or infotainment issues.

templates.scenario_zh: 车辆本身空调不制冷/不出风/吹热风/热泵问题
templates.scenario_en: The customer reports that the vehicle's air conditioning has a problem, such as not cooling, not blowing air, blowing hot air, or a heat pump issue. This refers to a vehicle HVAC malfunction rather than an app or bind vehicle issue.

templates.scenario_zh: AEB/ACC/LKA/TSR/限速识别/前碰撞误触发/车道辅助异常
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports abnormal behavior related to driver assistance functions, including AEB, ACC, LKA, TSR, speed limit recognition, false front collision warnings, or lane assist issues. The customer may describe unexpected alerts, incorrect recognition, or malfunction of these vehicle safety and assistance features.

templates.scenario_zh: 仪表报警/发动机排放故障/电池系统故障/安全气囊/AVM故障
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports a dashboard warning or fault involving engine emission, battery system, airbag, or the AVM system in the vehicle. The email may describe warning lights, fault messages, or related issues shown on the instrument cluster or infotainment.

templates.scenario_zh: 车辆功能如何使用：油耗显示、无线 CarPlay、胎压、音响 fader、点烟器位置、保养里程、热点密码等
templates.scenario_en: How to use a vehicle function such as fuel display, wireless CarPlay, tyre pressure, fader, cigarette lighter, service interval, hotspot password.

templates.scenario_zh: 保养记录、保修状态、维修进度、服务计划、维修费用、事故维修，请求预约维修
templates.scenario_en: Service history, warranty, repair progress, booking, or maintenance-alert remaining km/days; no backend lookup.

templates.scenario_zh: 查找附近服务点/授权服务位置/inspection near me
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer asks how to find a nearby service point, authorized service location, or inspection location for their vehicle. This includes requests for the nearest place to perform service, maintenance, or inspection.

templates.scenario_zh: App 布局、快捷指令、通知声音、用户配置、Dashcam、常用功能置顶等建议
templates.scenario_en: The customer is providing suggestions or feedback about app experience and feature design, such as app layout, shortcuts, notification sound, user configuration, dashcam, or pinning frequently used functions to the top. This scenario applies when the email is about improvement ideas or customization requests rather than troubleshooting a specific fault.

templates.scenario_zh: 客户希望充电停止/未达目标时 App 主动通知
templates.scenario_en: The customer wants the app to proactively send a notification if vehicle charging stops unexpectedly or does not reach the target charging level. This applies when the customer is requesting a charging reminder or alert for incomplete charging.

templates.scenario_zh: 客户希望远程升降车窗/忘关窗可用 App 关闭
templates.scenario_en: The customer wants to remotely raise or lower the vehicle windows, or use the app to close the windows if they forgot to close them. This applies when the customer is asking whether remote window control is available in the app.

templates.scenario_zh: 行车日志、旅程记录、总里程、油耗统计、公司车管理
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer asks about driving logs, trip records, total mileage, fuel consumption statistics, or company vehicle management in the app or vehicle-related services.

templates.scenario_zh: 客户回复问题已解决/正常工作
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer replies that the issue has been resolved or the function is working normally again. The customer indicates that no further troubleshooting or assistance is needed.

templates.scenario_zh: 无有效内容、无法理解、乱码、仅问候、相同发件人且相同正文
templates.scenario_en: Apply this template when the customer email contains no valid content, cannot be understood, is garbled text, only includes a greeting, or is a duplicate email from the same sender with the same message body.

templates.scenario_zh: App地图、车辆位置、发送目的地、找充电站/兴趣点等 App 地图功能异常
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports abnormal app map functions, such as vehicle location not displaying correctly, being unable to send a destination to the vehicle, or being unable to find charging stations or points of interest in the app map. This includes issues with map-based features in the app rather than infotainment navigation.

templates.scenario_zh: App 能耗、统计、油耗/电耗、行程统计不显示或不准确
templates.scenario_en: The customer reports that energy consumption data in the app, including fuel consumption, electric consumption, or trip statistics, is not displayed or is inaccurate. This applies when the app shows missing, incomplete, delayed, or incorrect energy or trip-related statistics for the vehicle.

templates.scenario_zh: 充电目标/模式保存后恢复默认，如 100% 回到 80%
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports that the charging target or charging mode does not stay saved and returns to the default setting after being changed, such as changing from 80% to 100% and then reverting back to 80%.

templates.scenario_zh: App 车辆图片、颜色、VIN、车型图显示不符
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports that the vehicle information shown in the app does not match the actual vehicle, such as the vehicle image, color, VIN, or model image being incorrect.

templates.scenario_zh: 客户需要绑车教程
templates.scenario_en: The customer needs a tutorial or step-by-step instructions on how to bind a vehicle in the app. This applies when the customer is asking for guidance on the vehicle binding process rather than reporting a specific troubleshooting issue.

templates.scenario_zh: 二级账号/副账号设置教程
templates.scenario_en: How to add a secondary account: the second user registers first, then the main account authorizes them in eight in-app steps.

templates.scenario_zh: App 版本更新、App 安装/打不开/崩溃/缓存问题
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports an app version update issue, or when the app cannot be installed, cannot be opened, crashes, or has cache-related problems. It also applies when basic troubleshooting such as clearing cache or reinstalling the app may be needed.

templates.scenario_zh: 后台/云端车辆信息缺失，App 或车机提示无车辆信息
templates.scenario_en: The vehicle information is missing in the backend or cloud, and the customer sees a prompt in the app or infotainment that there is no vehicle information. Use this scenario when the customer reports that the vehicle cannot display or retrieve vehicle details because the backend data is missing.

templates.scenario_zh: 客户要求历史定位、报警记录、服务记录、个人/车辆数据导出
templates.scenario_en: The customer requests export of historical location data, alarm records, service records, or personal/vehicle data. This applies when the customer asks to obtain or download data related to their account or bound vehicle.

templates.scenario_zh: Amazon Music/Spotify/在线音乐不可用、应用缺失
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports that Amazon Music, Spotify, or other online music services are unavailable in the vehicle infotainment system, or that the music app is missing from the app list.

templates.scenario_zh: Hello MG/语音助手不可用、语音语言不支持
templates.scenario_en: Apply this template when the customer reports that Hello MG or the voice assistant is unavailable, not responding, or cannot be used, or when the customer says the requested voice language is not supported in the vehicle or infotainment system.

templates.scenario_zh: 导航声音、收音机被导航打断、音量/静音设置问题
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports issues with navigation audio, such as navigation voice prompts, the radio being interrupted by navigation, or problems with volume or mute settings in the vehicle infotainment system.

templates.scenario_zh: 驾驶模式、MG Pilot、自定义设置、限速报警每次重启恢复默认
templates.scenario_en: The customer reports that driving mode, MG Pilot, custom settings, or the speed limit warning return to the default setting every time the vehicle is restarted. This applies when personalized vehicle settings are not saved after power off and restart.

templates.scenario_zh: 隐私状态频繁接受/拒绝跳变、App 多次推送隐私通知
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports that the privacy consent status keeps switching repeatedly between accepted and declined, or the app pushes privacy notifications multiple times. The issue may describe frequent privacy status changes or repeated privacy-related messages in the app.

templates.scenario_zh: 车机自动重启、卡死、循环重启
templates.scenario_en: Apply this template when the customer reports that the vehicle infotainment automatically restarts, freezes, or gets stuck in a continuous reboot loop. This covers repeated rebooting, crashing, or the screen becoming unresponsive before restarting.

templates.scenario_zh: App/车机翻译错误、文案不准确、按钮显示手机号码但应为邮箱等
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports translation errors or inaccurate wording in the app or infotainment, such as incorrect language, mistranslated text, truncated text, or a button showing a phone number when it should display an email address. This also applies when the customer points out incorrect labels or display text in the interface.

templates.scenario_zh: 客户希望 OTA 更新、询问是否支持 OTA、地图是否 OTA
templates.scenario_en: The customer wants an OTA update for the vehicle, asks whether the vehicle supports OTA, or asks whether map updates are provided through OTA. This includes questions about remote software updates for the vehicle or infotainment system.

templates.scenario_zh: 客户希望在 App/车机调节充电功率/电流
templates.scenario_en: The customer wants to adjust the charging power or charging current in the app or on the vehicle infotainment system. This applies when the customer is asking how to change the charging current limit or power setting during vehicle charging.

templates.scenario_zh: 客户希望手表 App/Apple Watch 操作车辆
templates.scenario_en: The customer wants to operate or control the vehicle using the watch app or Apple Watch app. This applies when the customer is asking whether vehicle functions are supported on Apple Watch or wants help using the watch app with the vehicle.

templates.scenario_zh: 充电速度低、快充功率达不到宣传/桩额定功率
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports that the vehicle's charging speed is low, or that fast charging power does not reach the advertised level or the charger's rated power. The issue concerns charging performance being lower than expected during fast charging.

templates.scenario_zh: 钥匙丢失、钥匙锁车内、无法开门/启动车辆
templates.scenario_en: Apply this template when the customer reports that the vehicle key is missing, the key is locked inside the vehicle, or the customer cannot open the door or start the vehicle. This includes cases where the vehicle cannot detect the key or access is blocked due to a key-related issue.

templates.scenario_zh: 远程空调触发车内报警/入侵报警
templates.scenario_en: Apply this template when the customer reports that starting the remote climate function causes the vehicle's interior alarm or intrusion alarm to be triggered. The customer may describe that the alarm goes off when remote air conditioning is activated through the app.

templates.scenario_zh: 自适应巡航、巡航控制、拖车/自行车架导致巡航不可用
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports that adaptive cruise or cruise control is unavailable, and the issue may be caused by a trailer hitch, towbar, trailer, or bicycle rack attached to the vehicle. The email may describe that cruise features stopped working after adding towing equipment or a bike rack.

templates.scenario_zh: 前碰撞/自动刹车误触发或不触发
templates.scenario_en: The customer reports that the vehicle's front collision warning or automatic emergency braking triggers unexpectedly, or does not trigger when it should. This applies to issues involving false activation or failure to activate the front collision/automatic braking function.

templates.scenario_zh: 车道保持/方向盘自动偏转/车辆向左偏
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports a lane keeping issue, automatic steering wheel deviation, or that the vehicle pulls to the left while driving. The customer may describe abnormal steering behavior related to lane keeping assistance.

templates.scenario_zh: 交通拥堵辅助/车道居中/低速辅助异常
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports an abnormal issue with traffic jam assist, lane centering, or low speed assist on the vehicle. The customer may describe that these driver assistance functions are unavailable, not working properly, or behaving unexpectedly during use.

templates.scenario_zh: 仪表语言/时间/温度/里程显示、故障提示等 IPK 问题
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer reports IPK or instrument cluster issues, such as incorrect language, time, temperature, or mileage display, or fault and warning messages shown on the vehicle dashboard. It applies to display-related problems and warning indications in the instrument panel.

templates.scenario_zh: 车漆、轮毂、玻璃、灯罩进水、内饰登磨损/额外车内外部件购买咨询/维修
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when a customer reports appearance or trim issues with the vehicle, such as paint damage, wheel rim damage, glass damage, water ingress in the lamp cover, or interior wear. This includes exterior cosmetic defects and visible interior material deterioration.
keywords_existing:
1. 车漆（Paint）
paint scratch / paint chip / paint damage
paint touch-up / repaint / paint repair
clear coat damage / paint fading / peeling paint
paint protection film / ceramic coating / paint correction
2. 轮毂（Wheel / Rim）
wheel damage / rim damage / bent rim
curb rash / wheel scratch / alloy wheel repair
wheel refurbishment / wheel replacement / hub cap
wheel polishing / cracked rim
3. 玻璃（Glass / Windshield）
windshield crack / windshield chip / windshield damage
glass replacement / window glass repair
broken window / cracked glass
glass tinting / sunroof glass
4. 灯罩进水（Light / Headlight）
water in headlight / moisture in headlight
headlight condensation / foggy headlight / fogged up headlight
headlight leak / water in taillight
headlight replacement / light housing seal / dim headlight
5. 内饰磨损（Interior Wear）
interior wear / seat damage / leather wear
upholstery repair / torn seat / cracked dashboard
interior stain / carpet cleaning / interior detailing
6. 车内外部件购买咨询（Accessories / Parts）
car accessories / aftermarket parts / genuine parts
floor mats / seat covers / roof rack / spoiler
body kit / bumper / mud flaps / trunk liner
replacement parts / part availability / price quote

templates.scenario_zh: 车辆不是我方负责制造/后台搜不到/Maxus或其他品牌 App 不兼容
templates.scenario_en: Use this template when the customer's vehicle was not manufactured by us, cannot be found in the backend by VIN, or belongs to Maxus or another brand whose app is not compatible with this vehicle. This includes cases where the customer is trying to use the app for an unsupported vehicle.

templates.scenario_zh: 客户希望多个主账号绑定同一辆车，不想用副账号
templates.scenario_en: The customer wants more than one primary account to bind the same vehicle and does not want to use a secondary account. This applies when the customer asks whether multiple main accounts can bind one vehicle instead of sharing access through a sub-account.

templates.scenario_zh: App 主题/深浅色/界面自定义诉求
templates.scenario_en: Apply this template when the customer requests app appearance customization, such as changing the theme, switching between dark mode and light mode, or adjusting the app interface style. This includes feedback or requests about personalized display settings in the app.

templates.l2_category: 新需求-App-分时段预约充电
templates.scenario_zh: 希望多个时间段预约充电/复杂电价策略
templates.scenario_en: The customer wants to set up charging reservations across multiple time periods or use a complex electricity tariff strategy in the app or vehicle charging settings. This applies when the customer asks about configuring more than one charging schedule to match different peak and off-peak rates.

templates.scenario_zh: 希望 App 预约保养/查看服务计划
templates.scenario_en: The customer wants to book a vehicle maintenance or service appointment in the app, or wants to view the vehicle's service plan in the app.

templates.scenario_zh: 希望预约座椅加热/远程座椅加热
templates.scenario_en: The customer wants to schedule seat heating or use remote seat heating for the vehicle. This applies when the customer is asking how to set up or use the seat heating feature in the app or vehicle.

templates.scenario_zh: 希望 App 远程关闭车灯/灯光控制
templates.scenario_en: Customer wants to use the app to remotely turn off the vehicle lights through the light control feature.

templates.scenario_zh: EV Trip Planner、路线规划、从手机发送路线到车机
templates.scenario_en: This scenario applies when a customer is asking about EV Trip Planner or route planning in the app, especially how to send a planned route or destination from the phone to the vehicle infotainment. It includes issues where the route cannot be transferred from the app to the vehicle.

templates.scenario_zh: 客户问如何在 App 设置充电时段（off-peak）
templates.scenario_en: The customer asks how to set an off-peak charging schedule in the app. This applies when the customer wants to configure charging time periods or timer-based charging for the vehicle.

templates.scenario_zh: 数字钥匙无法连接、无法用手机解锁/锁车、配对或激活失败（非钥匙锁在车内）
templates.scenario_en: The digital key cannot connect, cannot lock or unlock with the phone, or pairing and activation failed. This is not the keys-locked-inside case.

templates.scenario_zh: 实体钥匙锁在车内、客户无法进车或滞留停车场，需要人工评估救援路径
templates.scenario_en: The physical keys are locked inside the vehicle and the customer cannot get in, or is stranded in a parking area. Human review is required for roadside assistance options.

templates.scenario_zh: 数字钥匙保活/Service Active 通知
templates.scenario_en: The customer received a Digital Key stay-active or Service Active notification and asks what it means or how to turn it off.

templates.scenario_zh: 如何开巡航/只有限速器
templates.scenario_en: The customer asks how to activate cruise control and only the speed limiter is available, with no assistance-system fault described.

templates.scenario_zh: 胎压报警去经销商还是轮胎店
templates.scenario_en: The customer has a tyre-pressure warning and asks whether to visit an MG dealer or any tyre shop.

templates.scenario_zh: 行驶中动力中断/拖车/保修
templates.scenario_en: The combustion engine or powertrain stopped while driving, a tow truck was needed, and the customer asks about warranty.

templates.scenario_zh: 咨询账号一次性能登陆在几个设备上，咨询绑车和账号的对应关系
templates.scenario_en: The customer asks customer care to change their personal address on file.

templates.scenario_zh: 副账号授权报未注册：核对方是否已注册并请提供账号后台查询（审稿第三列）
templates.scenario_en: The App says the other user is not registered. Ask for that iSMART account (email or phone) so CS can check the backend. Do not send the eight-step how-to.

templates.scenario_zh: 找不到蓝牙钥匙入口/蓝牙钥匙如何激活
templates.scenario_en: How to find and activate Digital Key in the iSMART App. Attach Digital Key Function.pdf.

templates.scenario_zh: 无法启用蓝牙钥匙/蓝牙钥匙无法启动车辆
templates.scenario_en: Digital Key cannot start the vehicle after activation attempts.

templates.scenario_zh: 一个账号下多辆车/删除不属于自己的车辆/车辆管理位置
templates.scenario_en: Vehicle binding follow-up scenario from 20260908 knowledge base.

templates.scenario_zh: APP续航里程单位切换
templates.scenario_en: The customer wants to change the distance or measurement unit shown in the iSMART App between metric and imperial, or reports that kilometres/miles reset after clearing cache or reinstalling the app.

templates.scenario_zh: 客户要求去掉 VPN 限制。有专属行：请客户关闭 VPN 再试 App，不套 NET-001 热点/月初流量。
templates.scenario_en: The customer asks to remove a VPN restriction. Ask them to test the app without a VPN. Do not use the hotspot or monthly data template.

templates.scenario_zh: 使用 Android Auto/CarPlay 时方向盘卡顿、右侧仪表/车机重启、导航崩溃、限速识别失效。进店功能检测，不要删配对。
templates.scenario_en: While using Android Auto or CarPlay the steering lags, the cluster or infotainment restarts, navigation crashes, or speed-limit detection fails. Arrange a vehicle function check of the infotainment. Do not send the delete-and-re-pair CarPlay steps.

templates.scenario_zh: 导航语音没声音，没有播报
templates.scenario_en: The customer reports poor GPS or map quality, street search, or charging-station data, and asks when maps will be updated. Record the feedback and send them to the dealer for a newer map or infotainment software. Do not first ask only for a software-version screenshot.

templates.scenario_zh: 扫码绑车无法识别二维码，扫码后提示二维码无法识别/请重试/请联系我们
templates.scenario_en: QR bind cannot be recognized; scan says try again or contact us.

templates.scenario_zh: APP预约充电指令下发无效，APP充电管理页面没数据，无法查看充电状态，APP预约充电时间与实际充电时间不一致
templates.scenario_en: Charging management page empty, scheduled charge invalid, or charge status missing in the app.

templates.scenario_zh: app一直提示胎压过低报警
templates.scenario_en: App keeps showing a low tyre-pressure alarm notification.

templates.scenario_zh: 如何更换导航语言
templates.scenario_en: How to change navigation language; it follows infotainment Settings > Language.
keywords_existing: how to change the language of the navigation system
keywords_extracted: how to change the language of the navigation system
keywords_all: how to change the language of the navigation system

templates.scenario_zh: 抱怨油耗过高
templates.scenario_en: Complaint that fuel/petrol consumption is too high.

templates.scenario_zh: 咨询车体颜色的colour code
templates.scenario_en: Customer asks for the vehicle paint/colour code; dealer has the code, app shows colour name.

templates.scenario_zh: 没有远控空调温度调节页面，没有Digital key页面，无法使用Hello MG，别的车主有xx功能但自己没有
templates.scenario_en: A function page is missing in the app (Digital Key, climate slider, Hello MG) or other owners have it.

templates.scenario_zh: APP如何查看车辆总里程
templates.scenario_en: How to view total mileage in the iSMART app vehicle management card.

templates.scenario_zh: 把车卖了/归还/leasing结束后，要求删除账号，或请求客服帮其删除是账号
templates.scenario_en: Customer sold or returned a leased car and wants the iSMART account or personal data deleted; they must delete the account in the app.

templates.scenario_zh: 绑多辆车需求，换车后换车绑需求
templates.scenario_en: Customer swapped cars or wants to bind another vehicle on the same account via Vehicle Management.
keywords_existing: bind another vehicle，change another vehicle to bind
keywords_extracted: bind another vehicle，change another vehicle to bind
keywords_all: bind another vehicle，change another vehicle to bind

templates.scenario_zh: Error code（具体数字）；车控命令失败但车态可读
templates.scenario_en: Use this scenario when the customer reports a specific error code and the vehicle control command fails in the app, but the vehicle status can still be read normally. This applies to cases where remote control functions do not work while vehicle state information remains available.

templates.scenario_zh: App 异常报警/入侵报警/胎压等通知频繁或疑似误报
templates.scenario_en: Apply this template when the customer reports that the app frequently sends abnormal alert, intrusion alert, tire pressure, or similar warning notifications, or suspects the alerts are false alarms. This includes repeated notifications that seem incorrect or triggered without an actual vehicle issue.

templates.scenario_zh: 请求删除帮忙副账号
templates.scenario_en: Customer asks CS to unlink or delete secondary accounts; CS cannot do it, they manage it in the app.
keywords_existing: Can you please unlink the 2 secondary accounts linked with my account
keywords_all: can you please unlink the 2 secondary accounts linked with my account

templates.scenario_zh: 地图/POI/街道搜索/充电桩数据质量差，询问何时更新。记录反馈并引导经销商查地图或车机软件版本。不要先只要软件版本截图。
templates.scenario_en: The customer reports poor map / POI / street search / charging-station data and asks when it will be updated. Record the feedback and point them to the dealer; do not first ask only for a software-version screenshot.

templates.scenario_zh: APP预约充电时间与实际充电时间不一致，APP设置充电目标值与实际充电目标值不匹配，设置充100%实际充80%就停了;设置充80%，实际会冲到100%
templates.scenario_en: Charge target 80/100 percent in the app does not match what the vehicle actually charges to, or the setting is not saved.

templates.scenario_zh: 隐私协议点同意后没反应，导致无法使用车控
templates.scenario_en: Customer cannot accept the privacy notice; tapping agree does nothing, so they cannot use remote control. Direct them to the dealer.
keywords_existing: don't allow to accept the privacy notice; can't accept privacy notice; no respond after tapping the "agree" button
keywords_all: don't allow to accept the privacy notice; can't accept privacy notice; no respond after tapping the "agree" button

templates.scenario_zh: 第三方后装件/改装件能否安装（Pedal Sprint、plug & play 等），需咨询配件厂家，不是 iSMART 功能
templates.scenario_en: Customer asks whether a third-party aftermarket accessory (plug-and-play pedal box, etc.) may be fitted. Advise them to contact the accessory manufacturer; iSMART cannot confirm compatibility.

templates.scenario_zh: 只说 App 很差，没有具体故障
templates.scenario_en: The customer only says the app is very bad and does not name a specific fault.
